[[File:V-19_hyperdrive_ring.png|thumb|right|250px|[[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] in a [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive ring]]]]
A '''modified version''' of the [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring]] was used by early models of [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] for travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], beginning in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="FF-2014 17: V-19">{{FactFile2014|17|V19 1-2|V-19 Torrent starfighter}}</ref> [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] hijacked a V-19 Torrent and got away with one of the hyperdrive rings after the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]]. After escaping the exploding [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Munificent-class star frigate]], Cad Bane sneaked aboard a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|Sheathipede-class transport shuttle]] disguised as [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]. After landing on the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], he walked away only to be noticed by Ahsoka, that he was injured. He kicked her in the chest and ran for a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] then docked with the hyperdrive ring. For the V-19 to dock, the fighter had to fly into the ring and raise its hinged lower [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] to link with the upper connector. The ring contained six nozzles.
